'''Leaptigs''' were [[Feline/Legends|cat-like]] predators native to the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. They [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] the mountains, plains, and valleys in packs, seeking out prey such as a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] and [[Grazer (Troiken)|grazers]] on Troiken.
